messages:
sara: Heads-up — seeing a sustained p95/p99 spike from 09:10->09:35 UTC on prod-region-2. Correlates with medium-length requests (≈80–160 tokens). Latency graph attached in dashboard.
jamal: Yup same. Throughput flat but tail latency jumps. I grabbed a flamegraph and this looks like a kernel switch thrash in the selector.
eva: Observed lots of KV cache evictions at the same time. Eviction rate spiked ~3x. Tenant pattern looks concentrated to a small set of heavy tenants :no_entry_sign:
liam: Can you paste the profiler snippet? suspected selector decision logs would help.
sara: Pasting recent logs — selector re-evaluating per-batch and flipping kernels frequently:
```
2026-03-18T09:12:03Z selector: chosen=fp16-vec reason=throughput_estimate score=0.62
2026-03-18T09:12:03Z selector: fallback=fp16-slow reason=kv_pressure score=0.38
2026-03-18T09:12:04Z selector: chosen=fp16-slow reason=latency_est score=0.55
2026-03-18T09:12:04Z kvcache: evict tenant=tn-42 entries=142
2026-03-18T09:12:05Z selector: chosen=fp16-vec reason=throughput_estimate score=0.61
```
jamal: That alternating pattern will thrash the KV cache — different kernels change tokenization/segment alignment and the KV key shape, so warm entries don't match and get evicted.
eva: Also noticed batching heuristic shrinks batch windows briefly under perceived latency and then grows them back — oscillation with selector.
incident-bot: INC-2026-0318-PERF assigned -> Sev2. Notifying oncall.
liam: Immediate mitigations proposal:
- flip ff:selector_hysteresis=on (2s hysteresis to avoid per-batch flips)
- enable route:force-fallback for heavy tenants (tn-42/tn-19) to fp16-slow temporarily
- throttle: limit concurrent requests for tenant tn-42 to 40 rps
sara: I can flip the feature flag in Console. Command to set in prod (from ops playbook):
```
opsctl feature set selector_hysteresis=true --env=prod --expires=1h
```
jamal: I'll create a routing rule to pin tn-42+19 to fp16-slow for 30m:
```
routingctl set-rule --tenant tn-42,tn-19 --model-variant fp16-slow --ttl 30m
```
eva: Deployed small patch to kvcache prefetch disable (was re-enabling erroneously) — rolling to 4 nodes in region-2 now.
deploy-bot: rolling update started: kvcache-prefetch-fix -> 4/4 nodes
liam: After FF + routing + patch: p95 dropped from ~420ms -> ~130ms within 5 minutes. Eviction rate down 78%.
sara: Nice. Can we run a synthetic workload to confirm selector won't flip back? jamal can you run the mediumseq load test (suggest 1k qps with token dist centered at 120)?
jamal: Kicked off load test. Results in 12m: stable kernels, selector_hysteresis kept choice steady, minor edge flips only when resource pressure changed >10%.
eva: Recording root cause as: selector oscillation interacting with batching heuristics + kvcache key shape mismatch -> eviction cascade -> tail latency amplification. Short-term mitigations: selector hysteresis FF, tenant routing, concurrent throttle, prefetch bug fix. Long-term: selector should include kvcache-hotness signal and batching window smoothing.
liam: Action items:
- (jamal) create an RFC for selector to consume kvcache hit-rate signal + hysteresis (ETA 2w)
- (eva) fix tokenizer/key-stability between kernels or canonicalize KV keys (ETA 3w)
- (sara) add an automated alarm when eviction rate > 200/s or p95 > 300ms for 5m (ETA 1d)
- (oncall) keep throttles in place until morning (UTC)
sara: I'll draft a short postmortem blurb for #incidents and ping support about tenants who saw errors.
jamal: Will convert this thread into a short runbook entry under eng-runtime/perf-playbooks.
infra-bot: Note: cost impact of forcing fp16-slow for tn-42 estimated +12% on those requests.
sara: Aware. We'll re-evaluate once long-term fixes land.
incident-bot: INC-2026-0318-PERF updated -> mitigated. Keeping open for follow-up actions.
liam: Thanks everyone. Closing live triage — follow ups in RFCs and runbook tasks. :thumbsup:
